$comment: Regulatory rulepack for F23 (tendercraft-evaluate-throughput-PRD.md). RULES ARE DATA.
They live here and not in Python for two reasons. Rules change on a government timetable
and a code deploy is the wrong unit of change for that. And a tender must be re-checkable
years later against the rules that actually applied to it, which is why `version` is
They are also NOT in a prompt. A model that decides whether a tender is lawful is the
exact defect the base agent contract calls out. `evaluate/deterministic/rulepack.py`
reads this file and evaluates it arithmetically; CI already greps evaluate/deterministic/

reason that lands in the audit trail (F23-AC4). Per D13, a rule that cannot be justified
!! citation_verified IS FALSE ON EVERY RULE BELOW. !!

corpus: Manual for Procurement of Consultancy & Other Services 2022

rules.title: Annual turnover requirement is proportionate to the estimated value
rules.citation: GFR 2017 · Manual for Procurement of Goods 2022 — proportionate eligibility
rules.rationale: The single most common way an eligibility condition quietly restricts competition.

rules.title: Bid submission window meets the minimum for the tender's value and type
rules.citation: GFR 2017 — adequate time for bid preparation
rules.expected_template: ≥ {min} days between publication and the submission deadline
rules.rationale: A short window is functionally a restriction on who can bid.

rules.title: Two-envelope (technical + financial) used above the prescribed threshold
rules.rationale: Also the structural precondition for the base product's sealed-bid gate (F9).

rules.title: No brand, make or model named without 'or equivalent'
rules.citation: GFR 2017 — generic specifications; CVC guidance on tailor-made specifications
rules.expected_template: name the requirement generically, or add 'or equivalent'
rules.rationale: A brand-named spec is the clause most often cited when a tender is challenged.

rules.title: Similar-work experience requirement is proportionate to the estimated value
rules.citation: Manual for Procurement of Works 2022 — past experience criteria
rules.rationale: Demanding larger prior work than the tender itself excludes competent bidders by arithmetic.

rules.title: EMD within the prescribed band, with MSE and startup exemptions stated
rules.citation: GFR 2017 — earnest money deposit; MSE / startup exemptions
rules.expected_template: EMD within {band} of estimated value, and the exemption clause present
rules.rationale: A missing exemption clause is a compliance slip that only surfaces as a complaint.

rules.title: Pre-bid meeting scheduled where required, with adequate margin before the deadline
rules.citation: Manual for Procurement of Works 2022 — pre-bid conference
rules.expected_template: pre-bid meeting at least {margin} days before the deadline
rules.rationale: The cheapest available fix for ambiguity — a meeting held too late cannot change the document.

rules.title: Weights sum to 100, qualifying marks stated, QCBS ratio within the permitted band
rules.citation: GFR 2017 — QCBS; Manual for Procurement of Consultancy & Other Services 2022
rules.expected_template: weights sum to 100; qualifying marks stated; technical weight within {band}
rules.rationale: Shares its implementation with base F3's lock validation — one arithmetic, two callers.

rules.title: Every evaluation criterion states its evaluation method
rules.citation: GFR 2017 — criteria to be stated in the bidding document
rules.expected_template: state how this criterion will be evaluated and marked
rules.rationale: An unstated method is decided after bids are opened, which is the definition of an arbitrary award.

rules.title: No criterion stated in the narrative but absent from the rubric
rules.citation: GFR 2017 — evaluation strictly on stated criteria
rules.expected_template: add it to the rubric with marks, or remove it from the narrative
rules.rationale: A requirement the document demands but the rubric cannot score is the ambiguity TP1 describes.
